messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic-number field construction from elliptic curve packings

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area is realized by placing points at the images of 13 torsion points of a CM elliptic curve E with j-invariant 0 under a degree-13 isogeny composed with a real-analytic uniformization mapping the period parallelogram into [0,1]². The resulting 13 points have coordinates in the compositum Q(√3, √13, ζ13), and the minimum area over all 286 triangles equals 1/182, achieved by collinear triples on the rational 13-isogeny fibers."}
